headline: Louisa Proske Switches on the ‘Epic Brain’ to Direct ‘Macbeth’ at the Met
context: The rising director Louisa Proske makes her Metropolitan Opera debut with the season-opening “Macbeth,” a large-scale production that came with a ticking timer.
